title: Upcoming IPOs this week: Manipal Health, Juniper Green, MV Electrosystems, 8 other issues to open; 7 listings scheduled
summary: At least three mainboard IPOs—Manipal Health Enterprises, MV Electrosystems and Juniper Green Energy—are opening for subscription this week alongside eight SME issues. Manipal Health seeks to raise about ₹9,275 crore through fresh issuance and an offer for sale. MV Electrosystems and Juniper Green have set their price bands and lot sizes, with proceeds earmarked for working capital, debt repayment and corporate purposes. Seven companies are scheduled to list this week.
content:
Updated on July 27, 2026, 11:01 IST

Multi-speciality hospital operator Manipal Health Enterprises is seeking to raise ₹9,275.22 crore through a fresh issuance of ₹8,000 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of ₹1,275.22 crore.

At least three mainboard IPOs will go live this week. The primary market will witness at least three mainboard initial public offerings open for subscription this week. They include Manipal Health Enterprises, MV Electrosystems and Juniper Green Energy. SME IPOs that will go live include Propshop Events & Exhibitions, Advance Technoforge, Poojaa Precision Engg, HR Hygiene Products, Dhaval Packaging, Oneindig Technologies, GV Electricals and Fusion Klassroom Edutech.

Listings that are scheduled for this week include Indo-MIM, Xtranet Technologies, Lohia Corp, Gulf Lloyds, Metalic Technoforge, Shree Balaji Mala and Silverstorm Parks & Resorts.

Details on Manipal Health Enterprises

Manipal Health operates a pan-India network of multispecialty hospitals providing services ranging from outpatient care to tertiary and quaternary interventions. The company is seeking to raise ₹9,275.22 crore via a fresh issue of ₹8,000 crore and an OFS of ₹1,275.22 crore. The money raised will be used to repay borrowings of its subsidiary, Manipal Hospitals Private Ltd, acquire the minority stake in step-down unit Sahyadri Hospitals and for general corporate purposes. With a price band of ₹560 to ₹590 per share, a lot consists of 25 shares.

Details on MV Electrosystems

MV Electrosystems, a leading manufacturer of overhead electrification (OHE) products for railways, will open its issue on July 30. The issue, with a price band of ₹400 to ₹425 per share, will conclude on August 3. The ₹290 crore IPO is a fresh issuance of shares aggregating to ₹290 crore with no OFS component. Funds raised will be utilised for working capital requirements, investment in research, design and development activities for new power electronic equipment and corporate general purposes. An application consists of 34 shares and multiples thereof.

Details on Juniper Green Energy

The ₹1,800 crore book-build issue of renewable energy solutions provider Juniper Green Energy is exclusively a fresh issuance of equity shares. The initial share sale is open from July 30 to August 3. Objectives of the issue include repayment of certain borrowings of the company, its material subsidiary and a subsidiary, with a portion also earmarked for general corporate purposes. With a price band of ₹214 to ₹225 per share, a lot consists of 66 shares and multiples thereafter. Juniper Green Energy is a renewable independent power producer that develops, builds, operates and maintains utility-scale renewable energy projects via in-house EPC and O&M teams and generates revenue through the sale of electricity to various off-takers, including state and central government-backed entities.

Other IPOs and market activity

Several SME issues are also scheduled to open this week, broadening access for smaller investors and companies seeking capital. Meanwhile, seven companies have listing dates set for this week, indicating continued activity in both the primary and secondary markets.

Investor guidance and regulatory notes

Investors should carefully read prospectuses and related documents before participating in these issues. Proceeds across the highlighted IPOs are primarily earmarked for repayment of borrowings, working capital, R&D and general corporate purposes. Lot sizes and price bands vary by issue, so applicants should confirm eligibility and apply according to their risk profiles.

(Information extracted from the original report published on July 27, 2026. Verify final offer documents and timelines with official filings before making investment decisions.)
